name: Mauritania
headline: Mauritania: +3.6% growth in 2025, 1.6% inflation, debt 40% of GDP
sections: Mauritania is a $12.6 billion economy (2025), the world's 152nd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.6% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $7,676 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 4.6% of GDP (2025).

Consumer prices rose 1.6% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 9.6% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 10.3% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 22.9% (2025).
Gross government debt is 40% of GDP (2025), a moderate level that has fallen from 57% in 2020. The general government balance is −0.3% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −5.8% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 94% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 5.4% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 40% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 68.7 years (2024). Population: 4.6 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
